files.description_zh: 方案封面：以品牌的平行感知线与开放节点语法，把 AI 开启与 AI 关闭两条完全等价的服务线并列呈现，线上十个节点对应十个独立完成点，其中三个彩色开放节点标示三处重点区域。图内标注概念建议 / CONCEPT。
files.description_en: Proposal cover: using the brand's parallel sensory lines and open-node grammar, it places the AI-ON and AI-OFF service lines side by side as exact equivalents, with ten nodes standing for the ten independent-completion points and three coloured open nodes marking the three key areas. Labelled 概念建议 / CONCEPT on the image.

files.description_zh: 2 分 34 秒中文导览：城市智能的检验标准、AI 开启与关闭的服务等价、一条底线与三座实验院的空间骨架、三区两翼分工、十个独立完成点的评价意义，以及概念性质与边界声明。旁白由系统语音合成，无真人录音、无音乐、无实地录音。
files.description_en: A 2-minute-34-second Chinese guide covering the test of urban intelligence, service equivalence between AI ON and AI OFF, the spatial framework of one accessible spine and three sensory labs, the roles of the three areas and two wings, the evaluative purpose of the ten independent-completion points, and the conceptual scope and limits. Fully synthetic speech: no human recording, no music, no field audio.

files.title_zh: 万感京张 多模态短片（中文旁白 · 中英双语标注）
files.title_en: Every Sense Jing-Zhang multimodal short film (Chinese narration, bilingual on-screen labels)
files.description_zh: 63 秒短片，七个镜头：片头主题、总体结构与三处重点区、骨架与等价服务网络、三处重点区的人尺度运行合同、第 16 章交互场景的逐帧实录、品牌语法与文化底线、片尾边界声明。交互段实录连续呈现「播放引导流光」与「切换 AI 关闭」两次真实操作，切换前后十个独立完成节点的位置、以及已声明覆盖读数 10 / 10、2、3 / 3 完全不变（声明完整度，非现场绩效）。中文合成旁白，画面关键标注中英双语，中文字幕既烧录在画面上也提供外挂 WebVTT。无真人录音、无音乐、无实拍、无第三方素材、无生成式影像。
files.description_en: A 63-second film in seven shots: title, overall structure and the three key areas, the framework and equivalent service network, the human-scale operating contracts of the three key areas, a frame-accurate capture of the chapter-16 interactive scene, the brand grammar and cultural baseline, and the closing scope statement. The captured sequence performs two real interactions — play the guidance flow, then switch to AI OFF — after which the ten independent-completion nodes and the service readout of 10 / 10, 2 and 3 / 3 remain unchanged. Synthetic Chinese narration, bilingual on-screen labels, Chinese captions both burnt in and supplied as WebVTT. No human recording, no music, no live-action footage, no third-party assets, no generative imagery.
